name: v0.52.732
body:
## Known issues
- **Context meter after a reload or model switch (#8975).** For some sessions on custom or self-hosted endpoints, the
  context meter can show the default window (256K) instead of the model's real window after a page reload or a model
  switch. It corrects itself on the next turn. Compression and chats are unaffected. Context-management plugins that
  read WebUI's context window see the same default until then.
- Credentials can pair with the wrong URL on Agent builds after hermes-agent #151775 when a providers: entry named like a built-in provider has its own URL and model.base_url differs (#8973, Form 3). Present in every release; not fixed yet.
- **"Always allow" on approvals WebUI holds (#9128).** With an Agent connected, "Always allow" on an approval that WebUI holds lasts for the session but isn't saved, so a new session asks again. It never allows more than you chose. It isn't fixed yet; #9128 tracks it.


## What's Changed
* docs(changelog): stamp v0.52.724 by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9264
* Release exp-v0.52.732: German reads as one consistent translation (#8787) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9265
* i18n(de): unify register and glossary, restore meaning lost against en by @goetterbote2342 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8787
